title: Declared action icons are dropped: RowActionInlineButton, RowActionMenuItem and QuickActionButton render the label only, so ActionSchema.icon (e.g. external-link on an "Open" action) never shows; CloudOnboardingNext hard-codes Rocket
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2911 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2936) gives the control plane's environment action 「打开」 (`sso_as_owner` on `sys_environment`, `list_item` + `record_header`) the declared `icon: 'external-link'`. The pinned console draws it without the icon. The os-dev on that card read it at objectui `ef71a09f`, unchanged at `main` `80863ade`. Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectui issue names `RowActionInlineButton`, `QuickActionButton` or a dropped action icon. objectui#12197 (generic SDUI blocks for product pages) may absorb the hero half; it is noted below and not duplicated.

## Where
- **Row actions:** `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx`.
  - `RowActionInlineButton` (L498) renders only `def.label` (L518).
  - `RowActionMenuItem` (L410) does the same.
- **Record header:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx`. `QuickActionButton` (L361) renders only the label (L416). This is the `page:header` actions path.
- **The control-plane hero:** `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/CloudOnboardingNext.tsx`.
  - L201 hard-codes the `Rocket` icon on the 进入工作区 button.
  - The props interface (L43–66) declares no icon key, so cloud cannot declare `external-link` for an action that opens a new tab.
  - If objectui#12197 replaces this component with generic blocks, its button should take the declared icon; otherwise this card covers it.

Seam: spec `ActionSchema.icon` → these renderers.

## Done when
- A declared action `icon` is drawn on the inline row button, the row menu item and the record-header quick action.
- The control-plane hero's open button takes a declared icon.
- Tests pin each.

**Not browser-measured** in the filing session. The finding is read from source at both shas.
